findings.title: architecture.md describes mutual import that no longer exists
signals_cited: docs/architecture.md stale 582 days behind the code

evidence.quote:
`src/cart` owns items and totals, `src/checkout` owns the flow. Pricing and
stock currently import each other through `src/cart/stock.ts`.

findings.note: Doc claims pricing and stock import each other (a cycle) through stock.ts. Code shows only a one-way import: pricing.ts imports reserve from stock.ts; stock.ts imports only a type from cart.ts, not from pricing.ts. No cycle exists between pricing and stock.

findings.title: README missing CONTRIBUTING, ADR, and CHANGELOG documentation

evidence.quote:
# web-ts

Cart and checkout front end.

    npm test

findings.note: Repository has no CONTRIBUTING, ADR directory, or CHANGELOG, and README does not mention or link to any; a reader has no guidance on contribution process or change history for a project already at v1.1.0 with a flag/feature history (see src/flags.ts).

looks_bad_but_fine.why: checkout.ts and flags.ts are not mentioned in docs/architecture.md, but architecture.md only scopes itself to cart/stock/pricing coupling and does not claim to be exhaustive, so this is an incompleteness rather than a contradiction.

not_assessed: Whether README.md and docs/architecture.md are literally 582 days older than the current code (accepted as given signal; git log was not independently queried since no shell tool was available in this read-only pass).
Test coverage percentage vs the jest coverageThreshold of 80% lines in package.json.
Any deprecation status of tiny-emitter or other dependencies.
